config.twinny.enabled.markdownDescriptio: Toggles the Twinny extension on or off. When `true`, Twinny is active and ready to provide completions.
config.twinny.enabledLanguages.markdownD:
Specifies which languages to enable completions with Twinny for. Use `*` as the default for all languages. Example:
```json
{
  "*": true,
  "python": true,
  "javascript": false
}
```
config.twinny.locale.markdownDescription: Sets the locale for Twinny. The default is `en` (English).
config.twinny.autoSuggestEnabled.markdow: When `true`, Twinny will automatically suggest completions. You can still manually trigger completions using the default shortcut (`Alt+\`).
config.twinny.contextLength.markdownDesc: Specifies how many lines of context (before and after the current line) to include in Fill-in-Middle (FIM) prompts. A higher number provides more context but may slow down completions.
config.twinny.debounceWait.markdownDescr: Sets the delay (in milliseconds) before triggering the next completion. This helps reduce API calls and improve performance.
config.twinny.temperature.markdownDescri: Controls the randomness of the model's output. Lower values (e.g., 0.2) produce more focused and deterministic outputs, while higher values (e.g., 0.8) lead to more diverse and creative completions.
config.twinny.multilineCompletionsEnable: When `true`, Twinny will attempt to generate multi-line completions. This is an experimental feature and may not work perfectly in all scenarios.
config.twinny.maxLines.markdownDescripti: Sets the maximum number of lines for multi-line completions. Only applies when `twinny.multilineCompletionsEnabled` is `true`.
config.twinny.fileContextEnabled.markdow: When `true`, Twinny will scan neighboring documents to provide more context for completions. This is an experimental feature and may impact performance.
config.twinny.recentEditsEnabled.markdow: Shows the model the last few changes you made, in any open file, as short diffs. A half-done rename or a pattern being applied across a file then carries into completions. Up to 6 changes and 2,500 characters.
config.twinny.lspContextEnabled.markdown: Includes matching IntelliSense symbols and available type signatures in FIM context. Uses installed completion providers, with up to 20 suggestions, 2,000 characters and a 150 ms wait limit. Works independently of file context.
config.twinny.completionCacheEnabled.mar: Enables caching of Fill-in-Middle (FIM) completions for identical prompts. This can significantly improve performance but may use more memory.
config.twinny.numPredictChat.markdownDes: Sets the maximum number of tokens to generate for chat completions. Higher values allow for longer completions but may increase response time.
config.twinny.numPredictFim.markdownDesc: Defines the maximum number of tokens for Fill-in-Middle (FIM) completions. Use `-1` for no limit. Twinny will attempt to stop at logical line breaks regardless of this setting.
config.twinny.enableSubsequentCompletion: When `true`, Twinny will continue to make completion requests to the API after the previous completion was accepted. This can provide a more fluid completion experience.
config.twinny.embeddingIgnoredGlobs.mark: Extra file patterns to skip when building embeddings, such as `**/*.md` or `**/fixtures/**`. Only source, config and documentation files are indexed to begin with; binaries such as fonts and images are always skipped.
config.twinny.embeddingUpdateOnSave.desc: Keep the workspace index current: re-embed a file when it is saved and forget it when it is deleted. Only applies once the workspace has been indexed.
config.twinny.ollamaHostname.markdownDes: Specifies the hostname for the Ollama API. Use `0.0.0.0` for localhost or provide a specific IP address or domain name.
config.twinny.ollamaApiPort.markdownDesc: Sets the port number for the Ollama API. The default is `11434`, but you can change it if your Ollama instance uses a different port.
config.twinny.p2pPort.markdownDescriptio: UDP port this computer listens on when sharing its Ollama with paired devices (Providers → Devices → Share). Devices on your network connect to this port, so a firewall on this computer must allow it, e.g. `sudo ufw allow 49737/udp`. Takes effect the next time sharing starts.
config.twinny.teamShareSlots.markdownDes: How many teammates' requests this computer runs at once while sharing it with the team (Providers → Share this computer). Takes effect the next time sharing starts.
config.twinny.keepAlive.markdownDescript: Sets the duration to keep models in memory for Ollama API. Use formats like `5m` for 5 minutes or `1h` for 1 hour. Set to `-1` to keep models in memory indefinitely.
config.twinny.warmUpModel.markdownDescri: Load the completion model when VS Code starts or regains focus, so the first completion does not wait for a cold model. Only for local model servers (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp); hosted APIs are never called.
config.twinny.ollamaUseTls.markdownDescr: When `true`, Twinny will use TLS encryption for connections to the Ollama API. Ensure your Ollama instance is configured for TLS before enabling this option.
config.twinny.secretShield.markdownDescr: **Secret shield.** API keys, tokens, private keys and passwords in a prompt (your question, attached files, the code around the cursor) are replaced with placeholders like `REDACTED_GITHUB_TOKEN_1` before the request is sent, and put back wherever the reply repeats a placeholder. The model never sees the value; the chat shows how many were withheld. Detection covers well-known token formats, private key blocks, passwords in URLs, and secret-named values in code and `.env` files.
config.twinny.secretShield.enum.0: Redact credentials in prompts sent to anything that is not on this machine: hosted APIs, a Twinny gateway, a paired device, a server elsewhere on the network.
config.twinny.secretShield.enum.1: Redact credentials in every prompt, local servers included.
config.twinny.enableLogging.markdownDesc: Writes what Twinny is doing to the **Twinny** output channel: one line per completion or chat request with model, timing, size and why it stopped. Set the channel's log level to *Debug* (the dropdown in the Output panel) to also see the prompts and replies. Warnings and errors are written even when this is off.
config.twinny.githubToken.markdownDescri: Your personal GitHub access token. This is used for fetching data from GitHub repositories. Keep this token secure and do not share it.
config.twinny.providerStorageLocation.ma: Specifies where to store Twinny provider configurations. 'globalState' uses VS Code's global state (persists per domain, may be lost if domain changes frequently). 'file' stores configurations in a file within the extension's global storage directory (more resilient to domain changes).
config.twinny.reviewMaxDiffChars.descrip: Characters of diff sent to the model per code-review request. Larger reviews are split into parts. Lower this for models with small context windows; raise it for large-context models to get fewer parts.
